Resolutions of 1964

14 resolutions, 64% unanimous. Decolonisation.

  • 186 (1964) Establishment of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
  • 187 (1964) Implementation of resolution 186 (1964) on the Cyprus question
  • 188 (1964) Complaint by Yemen regarding British air attack on Yemeni territory
  • 189 (1964) Complaint concerning acts of aggression against the territory and civilian population of Cambodia
  • 190 (1964) Urging the Government of South Africa to end the Rivonia trial against the leaders of the anti-apartheid movement
  • 191 (1964) Persons imprisoned, interned or sentenced to death for their opposition to the policy of apartheid
  • 192 (1964) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 193 (1964) Calling for a cease-fire in Cyprus
  • 194 (1964) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 195 (1964) Admission of Malawi to membership in the United Nations
  • 196 (1964) Admission of Malta to membership in the United Nations
  • 197 (1964) Admission of Zambia to membership in the United Nations
  • 198 (1964) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 199 (1964) The withdrawal of mercenary troops from the Democratic Republic of the Congo

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
